import copy
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import xml.parsers.expat
from datetime import datetime, timezone

base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
root=base.parents[1]
source=base/'RFModel_AMPM_A01.wsv'
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(source)=='ead90a212c786eff0cfa782dab47dbfe14c421b3f43b32c573bb990cb8348877'
plan_path=root/'validation/am-pm-point-derivative-plan-20261013.json'
assert sha(plan_path)=='8ab865ee8e8300e9201e3f111d0bfb674da98f51a6988de60920b4bbdddd5650'
plan=json.loads(plan_path.read_text())
original=ET.fromstring(source.read_bytes())
def item(node,*names):
    for name in names:
        rows=[c for c in node.findall('Item') if c.get('XName')==name]
        assert len(rows)==1,name
        node=rows[0]
    return node
def signature(n):
    return (n.tag,dict(n.attrib),n.text,tuple(signature(c) for c in n))
manifest={'schema_version':1,'prepared_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
          'plan_sha256':sha(plan_path),'source_sha256':sha(source),'profiles':[]}
for profile in plan['profiles']:
    document=copy.deepcopy(original)
    pd=item(document,'PointDerivative')
    amp=item(pd,'Sch1','PartList','RFAmp','ParamSet')
    src=item(pd,'Sch1','PartList','Source','ParamSet')
    sweep=item(pd,'System1','Path1')
    changes=[]
    def change(node,field,value,path):
        target=node.find(field);assert target is not None,(path,field)
        before=target.text;target.text=str(value)
        changes.append({'path':path+'/'+field,'before':before,'after':str(value)})
    for key,value in {'AMtoPM_Mode':1,'G':20,'OP1dB':100,'OPSAT':103,'OIP2':140,'OIP3':130,
                      'AMtoPM':profile['peak_degrees_per_db'],'PwrAMtoPM':profile['reference_dbm']}.items():
        change(item(amp,key),'DataEntry',value,'PointDerivative/Sch1/PartList/RFAmp/ParamSet/'+key)
    for key,value in {'Pwr':profile['ordinary_output_target_dbm']-20,'Phase':30}.items():
        change(item(src,key),'DataEntry',value,'PointDerivative/Sch1/PartList/Source/ParamSet/'+key)
    for key,value in {'QCStartPwr':profile['sweep_input_start_dbm'],'QCStopPwr':profile['sweep_input_stop_dbm'],'QCStepPwr':.25}.items():
        change(item(sweep,key),'DataEntry',value,'PointDerivative/System1/Path1/'+key)
    change(item(sweep,'QCAutoLimits'),'Data/D',0,'PointDerivative/System1/Path1/QCAutoLimits')
    change(item(sweep,'QCFreq'),'DataEntry',100,'PointDerivative/System1/Path1/QCFreq')
    change(item(sweep,'QCSwpType'),'Data/D',3,'PointDerivative/System1/Path1/QCSwpType')
    path=base/'profiles-v4'/profile['name']/'RFModel_AMPM_A01.wsv'
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
    raw=source.read_bytes()
    spans={};stack=[];active={}
    parser=xml.parsers.expat.ParserCreate()
    targets={row['path']:row['after'].encode('ascii') for row in changes}
    def begin(tag,attrs):
        if not stack:stack.append('')
        else:stack.append(attrs.get('XName',tag))
        key='/'.join(stack[1:])
        if key in targets:active[key]=(parser.CurrentByteIndex,tag)
    def end(tag):
        key='/'.join(stack[1:])
        if key in active:
            start,tag=active[key];tagend=raw.index(b'>',start)+1
            stop=tagend if raw[start:tagend].rstrip().endswith(b'/>') else raw.index(b'>',parser.CurrentByteIndex)+1
            spans[key]=(start,stop)
            targets[key]=b'<'+tag.encode()+b'>'+targets[key]+b'</'+tag.encode()+b'>'
        stack.pop()
    parser.StartElementHandler=begin;parser.EndElementHandler=end
    parser.Parse(raw,True)
    assert set(spans)==set(targets)
    payload=raw
    for key,(start,stop) in sorted(spans.items(),key=lambda x:x[1][0],reverse=True):
        payload=payload[:start]+targets[key]+payload[stop:]
    path.write_bytes(payload)
    assert signature(ET.fromstring(payload))==signature(document)
    # Undo only the listed changes and require the entire semantic tree to match.
    for row in changes:
        parts=row['path'].split('/'); target=document
        while parts and parts[0] not in ('DataEntry','Data'):
            target=item(target,parts.pop(0))
        target.find('/'.join(parts)).text=row['before']
    assert signature(document)==signature(original)
    manifest['profiles'].append({'name':profile['name'],'workspace_path':str(path.relative_to(root)),
                                 'workspace_sha256':sha(path),'changes':changes})
out=base/'prepared-workspaces-v4.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print('Prepared',len(manifest['profiles']),'independent workspaces with only planned parameter changes.')

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import uuid

root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
base=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('mode',choices=['open','inspect','baseline-pd','profile','recover','preflight','prepared','recover-xml'])
p.add_argument('--profile')
args=p.parse_args()
script=base/('recover-warning.ps1' if args.mode=='recover-xml' else 'capture-prepared-v4.ps1' if args.mode=='prepared' else 'preflight-v3.ps1' if args.mode=='preflight' else 'recover.ps1' if args.mode=='recover' else 'capture-profile.ps1' if args.mode=='profile' else 'open-baseline.ps1')
out=base/(args.mode+'-'+datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:8])
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
ps=Path('C:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe')
env=os.environ.copy();env['PSModulePath']=str(ps.parent/'Modules')
command=[str(ps),'-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-File',str(script),'-OutputDirectory',str(out)]
if args.mode in ('profile','prepared','recover-xml'):
    assert args.profile
    command+=['-Profile',args.profile]
elif args.mode!='recover':
    command+=['-Mode','open' if args.mode=='preflight' else args.mode]
state={'started_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'mode':args.mode,'profile':args.profile,
       'script_sha256':hashlib.sha256(script.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'command':command,
       'planned_analysis_calls':int(args.mode in ('baseline-pd','profile','prepared')),'timeout_seconds':120}
def save():
    (out/'status.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
save(); print('OUTPUT',out,flush=True)
with (out/'stdout.log').open('xb') as stdout,(out/'stderr.log').open('xb') as stderr:
    proc=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=stdout,stderr=stderr,env=env,creationflags=subprocess.CREATE_NO_WINDOW)
    state['helper_pid']=proc.pid;save()
    try:
        state['exit_code']=proc.wait(timeout=120)
        state['status']='returned'
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        proc.kill();proc.wait()
        state['status']='timeout_helper_only_terminated_application_not_restarted'
state['finished_utc']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat();save()
print(json.dumps(state,indent=2))
print((out/'stdout.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace'))
print((out/'stderr.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig',errors='replace'))
raise SystemExit(0 if state.get('exit_code')==0 else 1)
